title: Deliciu V2 Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt is an expertly crafted blend of bold, tangy blueberry and sharp, sour raspberry flavours. Each puff delivers a perfectly balanced fruity vape that strikes the ideal mix of sweet and tart, culminating in a deeply smooth, fruity finish. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
